title: Deep Learning / Jan-May 2024 - Konda Reddy Mopuri
description: of AI, IITH   **Deep Learning**   Jan-May 2024 |. # Deep Learning / Jan-May 2024. * Apr 18: New Lecture is up: (dl-21) Diffusion Models [slides]. * Apr 15: New Lecture is up: (dl-20) Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) [slides]. * Apr 01: New Lecture is up: (dl-19) Variational Autoencoders [slides]. * Mar 20: New Lecture is up: (dl-18) Generative Models [slides]. * Mar 18: New Lecture is up: (dl-17) Autoencoders [slides]. * Mar 11: New Lecture is up: (dl-16) Applications of Transformers [slides]. In this course, we will discuss (with a focus on the implementation) the various building blocks required to realize the Deep Learning solutions all the way from a simple neuron model to Generative AI. Starting from an artificial neuron model, the aim of this course is to understand feed-forward, recurrent architectures of Artificial Neural Networks, all the way to the latest Generative AI models driven by Deep Neural Networks.
